summary: The Health DATA Act of 2026 amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA) to ensure that group health plan fiduciaries have direct access to health claims, encounter information, pricing terms, and related documentation from network service providers without unreasonable delays or restrictive contract terms.

affected_groups.effect: Gain guaranteed, timely access to health claims, encounter data, pricing structures, and audit capabilities without restrictions from service providers.
affected_groups.group: Group health plan fiduciaries, plan sponsors, and plan administrators

affected_groups.effect: Must remove restrictive contract terms, provide data in standardized formats at no cost, comply with HIPAA, and face potential civil penalties of up to $10,000 per day for non-compliance.
affected_groups.group: Network service providers, third-party administrators, and pharmacy benefit managers

key_provisions: Requires contracts between group health plans and network service providers to allow responsible plan fiduciaries and designated agents access to all claims, encounter information, and supporting documentation.
Prohibits contracts from delaying data access beyond 15 days, limiting the amount of accessed data, or restricting access to alternative payment terms and overpayment details.
Mandates that information and data must be provided in a manner consistent with HIPAA privacy and security regulations.
Establishes standardized formats for institutional, professional, dental, and pharmacy claims, as well as electronic funds transfer and remittance advice notices, at no cost to the health plan.
Authorizes the Secretary of Labor to assess civil penalties of up to $10,000 per day against entities that violate these data access rules, and voids conflicting contract provisions.
Requires group health plans or health insurance issuers to annually submit an attestation of compliance regarding the availability of price and quality information.
missing_information: The exact date of final enactment is not provided, as the bill is currently placed on the Union Calendar.
Specific details regarding the long-term economic cost or budgetary impact on federal agencies are not included.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Health DATA Act of 2026 amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA) to ensure that group health plan fiduciaries have direct access to health claims, encounter information, pricing terms, and related documentation from network service providers without unreasonable delays or restrictive contract terms.
summary_detail.significance: This legislation alters how group health plans interact with network service providers by mandating transparency and data sharing under ERISA. The bill applies to plan years beginning one year after enactment, impacting contracts regardless of when they were originally executed.
